prompt: Of the Jason Statham movies that came out the year Dennis Hopper died, which could he have lived to see the premiere of?
answer: None. Dennis Hopper died on May 29, 2010. Jason Statham’s films released that year were **13** and **The Expendables**, whose premieres occurred later—**13** in September 2010 and **The Expendables** in August 2010—so Hopper could not have seen either premiere.
